trap.label: sensível
trap.wrong: She is very sensible about criticism.
trap.right: She is very sensitive about criticism.
trap.why: Em português “sensível” parece com sensible, mas sensible significa sensato. Para emoção, use sensitive.

mcq.q: “Not as often as we like to think” sounds...

fix.wrong: It sounds like a sensible subject.
fix.right: It sounds like a sensitive subject.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com sensitive: “She is easily hurt by criticism.” (sensitive)
Reescreva com To some extent: “Partly, I agree.”
Reescreva com cautiously: “The speaker is cautious and optimistic.” (cautiously)
